description: This file implements core data structures and utilities for managing chunk-based data handling in the lighttpd2 server, including chunk file management, chunk iteration, chunk queue operations, and memory limit management.

classes.name: liChunkFile
classes.description: Represents a chunk file with reference counting, handling temporary status and safe opening of files.

classes.name: liChunk
classes.description: Represents a chunk of data (string, memory, file, buffer, or unused) used in chunk queues.

classes.name: liCQLimit
classes.description: Manages memory limits associated with chunk queues, including locking and notifying when limits are exceeded.

classes.name: liChunkQueue
classes.description: A queue of chunks, supporting operations for adding, removing, and managing data chunks with limit enforcement.

methods.name: liChunkFile * li_chunkfile_new(GString * name,int fd,gboolean is_temp)
methods.description: Creates a new liChunkFile object with specified name, file descriptor, and temp status.

methods.name: void li_chunkfile_acquire(liChunkFile * cf)
methods.description: Increments the reference count of a chunk file instance.

methods.name: void li_chunkfile_release(liChunkFile * cf)
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and frees a chunk file when no longer used.

methods.name: liHandlerResult li_chunkfile_open(liChunkFile * cf,GError ** err)
methods.description: Opens the file associated with a chunk file, setting its file descriptor if not already open.

methods.name: liHandlerResult li_chunkiter_read(liChunkIter iter,off_t start,off_t length,char ** data_start,off_t * data_len,GError ** err)
methods.description: Reads data from a chunk at a specified start position and length, handling different chunk types.

methods.name: liHandlerResult li_chunkiter_read_mmap(liChunkIter iter,off_t start,off_t length,char ** data_start,off_t * data_len,GError ** err)
methods.description: Attempts to memory-map data from a file chunk for efficient reading, falling back to pread if mmap fails.

methods.name: liChunk * chunk_new(void)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new chunk object.

methods.name: void chunk_free(liChunkQueue * cq,liChunk * c)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a chunk, including special handling for each chunk type.

methods.name: liCQLimit * li_cqlimit_new(void)
methods.description: Creates a new chunk queue limit object with default parameters.

methods.name: void li_cqlimit_reset(liCQLimit * cql)
methods.description: Resets the cqlimit object to default state.

methods.name: void li_cqlimit_acquire(liCQLimit * cql)
methods.description: Increments the reference count of a cqlimit instance.

methods.name: void li_cqlimit_release(liCQLimit * cql)
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and frees the cqlimit if no longer used.

methods.name: void li_cqlimit_set_limit(liCQLimit * cql,goffset limit)
methods.description: Sets a new limit for the cqlimit, adjusting lock status accordingly.

methods.name: liChunkQueue * li_chunkqueue_new(void)
methods.description: Creates a new empty chunk queue.

methods.name: void __chunk_free(gpointer _c,gpointer userdata)
methods.description: Helper function to free an individual chunk within a chunk queue.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_reset(liChunkQueue * cq)
methods.description: Resets a chunk queue, clearing all chunks and mem usage counters.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_free(liChunkQueue * cq)
methods.description: Frees all chunks and the chunk queue itself.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_use_limit(liChunkQueue * cq,goffset limit)
methods.description: Applies a memory limit to the chunk queue.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_set_limit(liChunkQueue * cq,liCQLimit * cql)
methods.description: Sets the limit for the chunk queue, replacing previous limit.

methods.name: goffset li_chunkqueue_limit_available(liChunkQueue * cq)
methods.description: Returns the available limit for additional data in the queue.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_append_string(liChunkQueue * cq,GString * str)
methods.description: Appends a GString as a chunk to the queue, transferring ownership.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_append_bytearr(liChunkQueue * cq,GByteArray * mem)
methods.description: Appends a GByteArray as a chunk, transferring ownership.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_append_buffer(liChunkQueue * cq,liBuffer * buffer)
methods.description: Appends a buffer reference to the queue.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_append_buffer2(liChunkQueue * cq,liBuffer * buffer,gsize offset,gsize length)
methods.description: Appends a portion of a buffer reference to the queue.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_append_mem(liChunkQueue * cq,const void * mem,gssize len)
methods.description: Copies raw memory into the queue as a chunk.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_append_chunkfile(liChunkQueue * cq,liChunkFile * cf,off_t start,off_t length)
methods.description: Appends a file chunk with increased reference count.

methods.name: void __chunkqueue_append_file(liChunkQueue * cq,GString * filename,off_t start,off_t length,int fd,gboolean is_temp)
methods.description: Helper function to append a file chunk, handling temp files and fd.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_append_file(liChunkQueue * cq,GString * filename,off_t start,off_t length)
methods.description: Appends a file chunk by filename, creating internal chunk file object.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_append_file_fd(liChunkQueue * cq,GString * filename,off_t start,off_t length,int fd)
methods.description: Appends a file chunk with an existing file descriptor.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_append_tempfile(liChunkQueue * cq,GString * filename,off_t start,off_t length)
methods.description: Appends a temporary file chunk.

methods.name: void li_chunkqueue_append_tempfile_fd(liChunkQueue * cq,GString * filename,off_t start,off_t length,int fd)
methods.description: Appends a temporary file chunk with existing fd.

methods.name: goffset li_chunkqueue_steal_len(liChunkQueue * out,liChunkQueue * in,goffset length)
methods.description: Transfers up to 'length' bytes between two chunk queues.

methods.name: goffset li_chunkqueue_steal_all(liChunkQueue * out,liChunkQueue * in)
methods.description: Transfers all chunks from one queue to another.

methods.name: goffset li_chunkqueue_steal_chunk(liChunkQueue * out,liChunkQueue * in)
methods.description: Transfers a single chunk from one queue to another.

methods.name: goffset li_chunkqueue_skip(liChunkQueue * cq,goffset length)
methods.description: Skips and removes up to 'length' bytes from the front of the queue.

methods.name: goffset li_chunkqueue_skip_all(liChunkQueue * cq)
methods.description: Removes all chunks from the queue.

methods.name: gboolean li_chunkqueue_extract_to(liChunkQueue * cq,goffset len,GString * dest,GError ** err)
methods.description: Extracts data from the queue into a GString.

methods.name: gboolean li_chunkqueue_extract_to_memory(liChunkQueue * cq,goffset len,void * dest,GError ** err)
methods.description: Extracts data into a memory buffer.

methods.name: gboolean li_chunkqueue_extract_to_bytearr(liChunkQueue * cq,goffset len,GByteArray * dest,GError ** err)
methods.description: Extracts data into a GByteArray.

methods.name: liBuffer * li_chunkqueue_get_last_buffer(liChunkQueue * cq,guint min_space)
methods.description: Returns the last buffer in the queue if it meets certain conditions.

methods.name: LI_API void li_chunkqueue_update_last_buffer_size(liChunkQueue * cq,goffset add_length)
methods.description: Updates the size of the last buffer after direct modification.

methods.description: unavailable

methods.description: unavailable
